ios.desc:
Meet White Screen – the minimalist app launcher designed to transform your home screen into a clean, focused space for productivity.

White Screen declutters your phone, reducing distractions and helping you spend less time doom scrolling. Instead, focus on what truly matters: your goals, well-being, and what brings you fulfillment.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Add your most-used apps to White Screen widgets.
- Use our custom wallpapers to blend seamlessly with your screen elements.
- Launch apps from White Screen widgets to keep your phone clutter-free.

WHAT CAN I DO WITH IT?

- Launch apps directly from White Screen widgets.
- Customize the look and feel to make your home screen uniquely yours.

WHITE SCREEN PREMIUM:

White Screen offers a lifetime plan that unlocks full access to all features, including unlimited apps per widget, custom backgrounds, and shortcuts. Upgrade to White Screen Premium and declutter your screen even further.

Feel free to consult our privacy policy here: https://astrochimp.framer.website/privacy and our terms of use here: https://astrochimp.framer.website/terms
